name: coding-discipline
description: Focused skills for investigating hard-to-explain failures and keeping confirmed project decisions current, with optional design discussion and TDD.

interface.shortDescription: Root-cause debugging and durable project decisions
interface.longDescription: Investigate failures with unclear causes and keep the current project spec aligned with confirmed decisions. Design discussion and test-driven development are available on demand.
defaultPrompt: Use systematic-debugging to find the root cause of this problem.
Use spec-sync to update the current specification with the decisions we just confirmed.
